role: Tests RespirationAnalyzer.estimateRespirationRate (RR-derived respiration via resample → Hann → DFT → 0.15-0.5 Hz peak): minimum sample count, known 15/12 br/min modulations, out-of-band inputs, constant and very short series.

units.does: Asserts 59 constant RR samples return nil (<60 guard).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Calls estimateRespirationRate on 60 constant samples and discards the result; asserts nothing.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: No assertion: the test only checks it does not crash; any return value, including a wrong rate, passes.

units.does: Builds 240 RR values 800±30 ms modulated at 0.25 Hz (time advancing 0.8 s per sample) and asserts a non-nil rate within 15±3 br/min at fs 4.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: appends one modulated RR value and advances t by 0.8 s

units.does: Builds 300 RR values 900±40 ms at 0.2 Hz (t += 0.9 s) and asserts a non-nil rate within 12±3 br/min.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Feeds 300 RR values with a 0.05 Hz (3 breaths/min) modulation and asserts no rate is returned: the band's largest bin is leakage from the slow rhythm (8.9 at the band's edge, a millionth of its power), which the breathing-peak test rejects.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Builds 360 RR values of approximately normal beat noise (sum of 12 uniforms from a fixed-seed linear congruential generator, ±40 ms around 950 ms) with no breathing in it, and asserts estimateRespirationRate returns nil.
Nested in testNoiseWithoutBreathingReturnsNil: advances the seeded LCG (state = (1103515245·state + 12345) mod 2^31) and returns state / 2^31 in [0, 1).
Feeds 300 RR values with 0.8 Hz modulation and asserts that if a rate is returned it is <= 40 br/min.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: asserts rate <= 40; nil passes with no assertion

flags.text: Assertion cannot fail: the band search caps the peak at 0.5 Hz (30 br/min) and a guard rejects >40, so the conditional assert is tautological; nil also passes.

With one RR per 0.8 s the 0.8 Hz modulation is above the beat-sampling Nyquist (0.625 Hz) and aliases; a Python replica of the estimator on this input returns 26.95 br/min, a plausible in-band rate, which the conditional <=40 assertion accepts. The test does not check rejection of high-rate input.

units.does: Asserts 200 constant RR samples return nil (no band power).
